I've answered Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket number is **#8841**.

That number comes from his own message in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He wrote that West yard Door 2 still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He's a member of that channel, so he could see it himself.

That message doesn't actually name Marrow Fieldworks. In the same exchange, Hollis had asked about "Tobias's dealer account," and I took that account to be Marrow Fieldworks. I found no Marrow Fieldworks account files to confirm it.

I left out the guessed ticket number Tobias sent me in a private message, because he asked me to keep it to myself.
